context: Asuka teaches Ren about vocabulary study.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: language lesson; vocabulary (博士/研究所/証明/単語/翻訳) in natural home.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 新しい単語、なかなか覚えられません。
lines.en: I struggle to remember new words.
lines.style: troubled young student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 単語は、例文と一緒に覚えましょう。
lines.en: Learn words together with example sentences.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 翻訳して、意味を確かめてもいいですか?
lines.en: Can I translate to confirm the meaning?
lines.style: curious young student voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、翻訳で意味を証明できます。
lines.en: Yes, translation helps prove the meaning.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 博士は、どう単語を覚えたんですか?
lines.en: How did you memorize words, doctor?
lines.style: engaged young student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 研究所で、毎日単語に触れました。
lines.en: At the institute, I touched words daily.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured instructive clarity throughout

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 翻訳の練習も、効果がありますか?
lines.style: thoughtful young student voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 効果は、研究でも証明されています。
lines.en: Its effect is proven in research too.
lines.style: warm teacher voice, soft warm measured closing clarity throughout
